_readme: SECRET keys that are legitimately absent from required-secrets.json because they are provider-gated or genuinely optional. The CI audit will not flag these as missing from required-secrets.json. They must still appear in the docker-compose env blocks and env example files.

optionalSecrets.reason: Provider-gated: only required when Transcription:Provider=AzureSpeech. Mutually exclusive with AzureOpenAIWhisper:* set. Both sets appear in required-secrets.json so operators know which to provision.
Provider-gated: only required when Transcription:Provider=AzureOpenAIWhisper (default). Mutually exclusive with AzureSpeech:* set.
